meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会进入对抗式规划:先声明“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”,复述请求,召集5个互相敌对的评审成员交叉批评,只保留经得起攻击的结论,最后必须交给 plan 智能体写出正式执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”等触发词,或要求对抗式/交叉批评式规划时触发;还需要 team 模式已开启、以 sisyphus 身份在主会话运行。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划一下这个项目怎么落地。
say.note: Claude 会启动对抗评审并产出执行计划。

say.text: 按 hpp 拆解这个新功能的实现步骤。
say.note: 5个成员互相挑刺,只留站得住的结论。

say.text: 用 /hyperplan 批判性地审核这份方案。
say.note: 先宣布进入 HYPERPLAN 模式,再开始评审。

howto.what_en: On load, Claude enters adversarial planning: announces 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!', restates your request, has 5 hostile reviewers cross-critique, keeps surviving insights, then hands them to the plan agent to write the executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan' or similar, or ask for adversarial/cross-critique planning. Requires team mode enabled, running as sisyphus in the main session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan how to launch this project.
say_en.note: Starts the adversarial review and produces a plan.

say_en.text: Use hpp to break down the steps for this feature.
say_en.note: Reviewers attack each other; only solid points remain.

say_en.text: Use /hyperplan to critically review this proposal.
